changes.old: On 4 November 2026, the ACCC decided that USCO’s notification lodged on 26 October 2026 should be taken not to have an effective notification date because it is materially incomplete under s 51ABY of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (CCA). Subject to any further timeline extension, the end of the Phase 1 determination period is 17 December 2026. The ACCC has prepared a questionnaire on the Acquisition. Submissions or information in response to the questionnaire should be provided by 12 November 2026 via email to mergers@accc.gov.au with the title Submission re: USCO – ITM. The ACCC's ability to give detailed consideration to submissions received after this time may be limited. The ACCC will take into account any submissions already provided in relation to this notification. If you have already provided a submission, you do not need to resubmit it unless you have additional information you would like to provide to the ACCC or to update your submission.
